description: A column (mj-column) inside a section; holds content blocks.

members.name: BackgroundColor
members.description: Gets or sets the background colour (background-color).

members.name: Blocks
members.description: Gets the content blocks held by this column.

members.name: Border
members.description: Gets or sets the border shorthand (border).

members.name: BorderRadius
members.description: Gets or sets the border radius (border-radius).

members.name: CssClass
members.description: Gets or sets the space-separated CSS class names (css-class).

members.name: ExtraAttributes
members.description: Gets or sets unmodelled attributes preserved for round-trip fidelity.

members.name: Id
members.description: Gets or sets the unique identifier of this column.

members.name: MjClasses
members.description: Gets or sets the referenced named MJML classes (mj-class).

members.name: Padding
members.description: Gets or sets the padding shorthand (padding).

members.name: VerticalAlign
members.description: Gets or sets the vertical alignment of content (vertical-align).

members.name: Width
members.description: Gets or sets the column width (width), e.g. "50%" or "200px". null means MJML splits the section width equally between columns.
